# PhaseSave

> Clean energy, born of the desert.

PhaseSave is an alternative-energy consultancy based in Palm Springs, California, founded in 2004, offering consulting, sales, engineering, and development for solar, phase-change material thermal storage, zero-water cooling, and resilient microgrids.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2004
- Founder / director: Eugene Buchanan (alternative-energy consultant)
- Parent organization: Trinity Concepts Inc., a Federal 501(c)(3) Community Development Financial Institution
- Location: 195 S Civic Dr Suite, Palm Springs, CA 92262 (Coachella Valley, Riverside County)
- Phone: +1 (760) 265-4209
- Email: Eugene@phasesave.com
- Track record: 20+ years advising, $42M+ in projects advised, 15+ countries served, 0 gallons of water used in cooling

## Services

- Energy Consulting & Feasibility — free initial consultation and site-specific modeling
- Solar — grid-tied, off-grid, demand response, and solar heating & cooling
- Thermal Storage & PCM — PhaseStore 10°C graphite phase-change material for peak shaving and load shifting
- Zero-Water Cooling — SkyCool radiative panels, pre-cooling mist, and passive envelopes
- Resilient Microgrids — solar-shaded aquaculture, pumped hydro, and low-head vortex turbines
- Cold Chain Logistics — PCM cold chain for health clinics and agriculture

## Flagship product — PhaseStore

Modular thermal energy storage for enterprise cooling. Capacity: 2 MWh per unit. Blackout autonomy: 72+ hours. Water use: 0 gallons. Typical payback: under 2 years. Charges 10°C graphite PCM off-peak and discharges at peak, supplemented by SkyCool radiative panels.

## Frequently asked questions

- What does PhaseSave do? — PhaseSave is an alternative-energy consultancy in Palm Springs, California, providing consulting, sales, engineering, and development for solar, thermal storage, zero-water cooling, and resilient microgrids.
- Where is PhaseSave located? — 195 S Civic Dr Suite, Palm Springs, CA 92262, serving the Coachella Valley, Southern California, and 15+ countries.
- What is PhaseStore thermal storage? — Modular storage that charges 10°C graphite PCM off-peak and discharges at peak, with SkyCool radiative cooling; ROI under 2 years.
- How much can thermal storage save on cooling? — Shifting a 2,000 kW load, 6 peak hours, from $0.34/kWh on-peak to $0.08/kWh off-peak can save roughly $770,000 per year before incentives.
- Does PhaseSave work on off-grid projects? — Yes: off-grid self-install solar kits, battery-less off-grid systems for AC motors, solar wells, mining, and refrigeration.
- Is the first consultation free? — Yes.

## Journal

- [The Desert Doesn't Have Water to Spare. Our Data Centers Shouldn't Need It.](https://phasesave.com/blog/zero-water-data-centers-coachella-valley/) — Why the Coachella Valley should host the digital economy without evaporative cooling water, via PhaseSave's three-layer approach: radiative sky cooling, phase-change thermal storage, and passive rack-side heat buffering. Argues for a "third way" between banning data centers and business as usual.
